categories.main_business_segments: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research, production, and sales of five-axis linkage CNC machine tools, high-end CNC systems, key functional components, and flexible automation production lines. Its product portfolio includes general-purpose five-axis vertical, horizontal, milling-turning composite, and gantry machining centers, as well as specialized machining centers such as tool grinding, blade machining, high-speed tip grinding, and six-axis five-linkage disk machining centers. The company also develops and sells high-end CNC systems, servo drives, motors, spindles, sensors, milling heads, and rotary tables. Additionally, it provides turnkey flexible automation production line solutions integrating machine tools, fixtures, tooling, logistics, and software systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core proprietary technologies including high-end CNC system technology, general and specialized five-axis CNC machine tool technology, direct-drive functional components, high-performance servo drive systems, high-precision sensing and detection, and high-performance torque and spindle motors. It emphasizes modular, platform-based design for rapid iteration and customization. Manufacturing methods include precision casting (e.g., mineral casting for machine beds), advanced machining, and integration of digital control systems. The company also capitalizes significant R&D expenditures to develop new models and technologies, such as AI integration for intelligent CNC systems and advanced multi-axis machining capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KEDE serves key customers in aerospace, aviation, military, energy, automotive, tooling, medical, semiconductor, and precision machinery industries. Major end markets include aerospace engine components, aircraft structural parts, automotive lightweight components, precision molds, medical implants, and energy equipment parts. The company has established close cooperation with leading domestic aerospace groups, energy enterprises, automotive manufacturers, and research institutions, supporting both military and civilian sectors. Its products are critical for manufacturing complex, high-precision parts such as turbine blades, disks, and rotors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales and production facilities in Northeast China (Dalian), Northwest China (Yinchuan), Southwest China (Chongqing), and other regions including East, North, South, and Central China. It serves customers nationwide and exports through distributors. The company’s production and R&D footprint covers multiple Chinese provinces, supporting a nationwide market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: KEDE operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the CNC machine tool supply chain. It manufactures complete high-end CNC machine tools and key functional components such as CNC systems, motors, spindles, and sensors. The company also provides integrated automation production lines, positioning itself as a system integrator and equipment supplier. It sources some standard parts externally but maintains high self-sufficiency (about 85%) in core components, enabling control over quality and innovation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on core technology self-reliance and import substitution, emphasizing platform-based product development and modular design. It invests heavily in R&D (over 26% of revenue) to advance five-axis CNC technology, high-end CNC systems, and key components. Current R&D priorities include AI integration for intelligent CNC systems, development of specialized machining centers for aerospace and new energy vehicles, and expansion of flexible automation production lines. KEDE also pursues collaboration with universities and research institutes to foster innovation and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: KEDE generates revenue primarily through direct sales of high-end CNC machine tools, CNC systems, key functional components, and flexible automation production lines. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales supported by technical pre-sales and after-sales services, supplemented by authorized distributors. The company also earns income from maintenance and technical services. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and acceptance of products or completion of services, with some sales through distributors recognized upon receipt of acceptance documents.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KEDE is positioned as a leading domestic innovator in high-end five-axis CNC machine tools and systems, competing against established international brands such as Mazak, DMG MORI, Siemens, and HEIDENHAIN. It holds a significant market share in China’s five-axis vertical machining center segment (about 13.6% by volume and 24.4% by value in 2022). The company differentiates itself through high self-sufficiency in core technologies, strong R&D capabilities, and tailored solutions for aerospace and other strategic industries, contributing to import substitution efforts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, KEDE achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 605 million, a 33.88% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 130 million, up 27.37%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.26 billion, growing 50.45% from the previous year, supported by capital increases and production capacity expansion. R&D investment accounted for 26.86% of revenue. The company’s cash flow from operations improved significantly, and it completed a major private placement raising nearly RMB 600 million to fund capacity expansion. KEDE demonstrates a strong growth trajectory with increasing market penetration and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KEDE emphasizes its core competitive advantages in proprietary high-end CNC system technology, comprehensive product platforms, and high self-sufficiency in key components, enabling superior product performance and reliability. Its five-axis linkage CNC machine tools offer high precision, efficiency, and flexibility for complex part machining, supporting critical aerospace and strategic industries. The company’s integrated pre-sales and after-sales technical services, rapid response, and customization capabilities enhance customer value. KEDE’s focus on import substitution and domestic innovation aligns with national strategic priorities, providing customers with cost-effective, high-quality alternatives to foreign products.
